title: Claude Fable 5.2 Solves Two Open Problems in Black-Hole Physics & 3D Quantum Gravity
aiSystem: Claude Fable 5.2 Autonomous Agent Fleet (Lean 4 Verified)
whyItMatters: Autonomously finished a 23-year-old Hawking–Page black-hole phase-transition calculation and proved the exact optimal 3D modular-bootstrap mass ceiling c/Λ—both verified in Lean.
summary: Anthropic deployed autonomous Claude Fable 5.2 agents across 22 self-proposed theoretical physics problems over six weeks. Two open problems in black-hole quantum gravity were solved and formally verified in Lean: (1) completing a 2003 calculation proving the Hawking–Page black-hole phase transition stays abrupt in weakly coupled N=4 super Yang–Mills, and (2) discovering a spectral-curve method proving the exact optimal ceiling c/Λ (Λ ≈ 9.1266) on the lightest black hole in 3D quantum gravity.
technicalHighlights: Settled a 23-year-old perturbative calculation in N=4 super Yang–Mills theory showing abrupt Hawking–Page phase transition at weak coupling.
Spotted a numerical pattern missed by physicists since 2009 and borrowed spectral-curve methods to prove the exact optimal 3D modular-bootstrap bound c/Λ (Λ ≈ 9.1266).
Both main results were formally verified in Lean 4 and checked by a human theoretical physicist before preprint release.
caveats: Preprints are unrefereed and describe idealized theoretical quantum-gravity models (AdS/CFT and 3D gravity) without direct experimental predictions for our universe.
contributors: Anthropic Theoretical Physics & Claude Fable 5.2 Team
